title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request clear privacy policies and terms of service from companies. Get transparent information about data use and rights.
description: A professional letter template to request clear, understandable privacy policies and terms of service from companies. Perfect for consumers seeking transparency about how their personal data is collected, used, and shared.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Clear Privacy Policy and Terms of Service Information

Dear Privacy Officer or Legal Team,

I am writing as a user of your services to request clarification regarding your privacy policy and terms of service. As someone who values my privacy rights, I would appreciate more transparent information about how my personal data is handled.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
I would like to request the following information:

1. A plain-language summary of your current privacy policy that explains:
 - What personal data you collect from users
 - How this data is used and processed
 - Whether data is shared with third parties and for what purposes
 - How long data is retained

2. Clear information about user rights, including:
 - How to access my personal data
 - How to request corrections or deletions
 - How to opt-out of data sharing or marketing communications
 - Contact information for privacy-related inquiries

sections.heading: Terms of Service Clarity
sections.content:
Regarding your terms of service, I would appreciate:

1. Notification procedures for policy changes, including:
 - How users will be informed of updates
 - Advance notice period before changes take effect
 - Whether continued use constitutes acceptance

2. Clear explanation of:
 - User obligations and prohibited activities
 - Service limitations and availability
 - Dispute resolution procedures
 - Account termination policies

sections.heading: Consent and Dark Patterns Concerns
sections.content:
I am also concerned about consent practices and would like information about:

1. How consent is obtained for data collection and processing
2. Whether users can provide granular consent for different data uses
3. Steps taken to avoid dark patterns in consent interfaces
4. How users can easily withdraw consent when desired

If your current consent mechanisms use confusing language, pre-checked boxes, or make it difficult to decline optional data processing, please consider implementing more user-friendly alternatives.

sections.heading: Request Timeline and Contact
sections.content:
I would appreciate a response within 30 days of receiving this letter. If you have already made improvements to your privacy policy or terms of service readability, please direct me to these updated resources.

For my privacy protection, I recommend using a privacy-focused browser when reviewing sensitive policy documents to prevent unnecessary tracking during the research process.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response and to continuing as an informed user of your services.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]

Getting transparency from mobile apps about data collection
Requesting plain-language terms from financial services
Asking e-commerce sites about customer data retention policies
